## The Nostradamus datacube, an Open Data Cube implementation

The **Nostradamus datacube** is the implementation of the Open Data Cube approach developed within the [Nostradamus project](https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101135941){target="_blank"}, adapted to the project's agricultural demonstration sites. It is deployed as a customised [**Cube-in-a-Box (CiaB)**](glossary.qmd#cube-in-a-box){target="_blank"}, one instance per demonstration site, in [Cyprus, Germany, Slovenia, Serbia, and Switzerland](nostradamus_datacube_overview.qmd#deployed-instances){target="_blank"}.

For installation instructions, usage guides, and the full list of data sources used in the Nostradamus datacube (and how they relate to the default Open Data Cube catalog), see the dedicated [**Nostradamus datacube**](nostradamus_datacube_overview.qmd){target="_blank"} section and its sub-pages.
